name: conditional_commit

test_list.description: Revalidate expected digest, mode and kind in the committing process under the workspace lock.
Never install staged bytes whose BLAKE3 differs from the approved manifest.
Reject traversal, protected targets and symlink parents before reading or mutating files.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Expected destination state and staged conditional file/link replacement or deletion.

output_description: Atomic same-filesystem installation under a cooperating-writer lock, a preserved conflict, or explicit backend rejection. Uncooperative OS writers remain a documented filesystem limitation.
